title: Independent load-bearing concern can be deferred
expected_summary: Turn 1 may raise cross-region failover as a load-bearing concern only if it is genuinely within the implied scope. When the user marks it out of scope, the next turn must record the boundary and not resolve the deferred design.

turns.user: Review the specification with the spec-grilling skill. Treat cross-region failover as a design concern that has not yet been scoped.
assertions: Raises cross-region failover as an independent design concern for a later release, while preserving single-region export scope.

turns.prior_assistant_response: S1 — Cross-region failover. A later failover design would affect replication and consistency. Recommend limiting this release to one region and deferring cross-region failover. accept · edit · out of scope
